rule_hypotheses.rule: Payout = min(covered charges, Max Benefit, rent-based cap) where rent cap = monthly rent rounded UP to the next $500; rent cap observed applied on a 2024 claim (868: rent 1875 -> 2000 although Max 3000).
2022-era claims paid the full Max Benefit without applying the rent cap (17: rent 1900 paid 4000; 20: rent 2095 paid 3500, no itemization at all).

When covered charges (unpaid in-term rent + damages/cleaning/rekey/lawn/trash + lease-break fee) exceed the cap, payout equals the cap exactly; most posted claims with large ledgers are cap-bound so line-item inclusion rules rarely matter.
Pet odor/ozone treatment is excluded (should be covered by pet policy) when tenant has a pet/animal fee.

Maintenance coordination fee charged by PM is covered (paid in 468: approved 200 = coordination fee only). Note: a misaligned Comments row says 'no coverage for lease violation-coordination fee', so coverage may vary.
Decline (0) when tenant entered a payment arrangement / agreement to pay with PM.
Decline (0) when tenant paid PM in full.
Decline (0) when tenant never paid the first full month's rent in full (check first full month charges vs payments in ledger).
Decline (0) when PM asks to void/withdraw the claim (e.g., tenant disputing charges).
Max Benefit generally equals the SD-waiver coverage amount in the lease addendum (20: 3500, 208: 2000, 868: 3000, 263: 3000) but not always (468: addendum 2100 vs Max 1500 = rent).
Declined claims with no ledger/itemization and no PM explanation are likely insufficient-documentation declines.

extraction_lessons: Workbook 'Comments' sheet keys comments by 'Row N' but those rows do NOT align with the current claims rows (Row 21 comments mention a different address and rent; Row 264 comment predates claim 263's claim date). Do not join Comments to claims by row number.

Excalibur Homes (GA) ledgers are 'Statement' format with signed amounts and a Balance Due; rent after move-out is reversed with an explicit negative 'Tenant vacated on X. Reversing...' line; damages appear as 'TBR Damages to Property Charges' lines with descriptions. Their 'No refund letter' is boilerplate and not an itemization.

Propertyware ledgers (New Heights / PURE SC) list newest first with running balances; 'Unpaid Charge' vs 'Paid Charge' status column identifies what is still owed; the top 'Total Unpaid' equals the claim balance. Payment rows describe exactly which charges they were applied to.

Rentmanager 'Transactions' ledgers (PURE TX / GDAA) show running balance; the move-out charges are the final lines ('Security Deposit Forfeit - Maintenance/Cleaning', 'Make Ready', 'Cleaning Fee'); vendor invoice in closeout packet reconciles to them.
PURE CA tenant ledgers (Appfolio style) end with 'Deposit Forfeit - <category>' lines that map cleanly to taxonomy categories, plus 'Utility Chargeback' and SDWP/RBP fees to exclude.

zInspector move-out evaluation/closeout PDFs are mostly photos; only the 'Additional Comments' block (or per-photo Comments) carries useful info (e.g., 'Strong pet odor, requires ozone machine'). Grep for 'Comments:' rather than reading all pages.
Several claims have no charge documents at all (only lease/addenda/mail receipts): 20, 263, 312. Scanned leases need vision; SD waiver addendum gives coverage amount.
Email chains (s2.pdf in 132) can reveal settlement/payment-arrangement facts that drive declines; PDF screenshots of DocuSign need vision.
Sheet Lease End Date is often blank; lease docs/renewals give the true term (needed for rent-after-lease-end exclusion).
